notes: E4 trigger-eval fixture set, data only: no router runs these yet. shouldTrigger texts name a triage task and contain a declared trigger term; shouldNotTrigger texts contain none; nearMiss texts contain a term (or close variant) but describe work the skill must not fire on — today's substring matcher would over-trigger on every near miss, which is exactly what R3's router has to fix. This set doubles as R3's validation suite.
